slope.definition: slope = (hit_rate_now - hit_rate_prev) / days_between. Units: hit-rate points per day.
slope.second_signal: mechanism_share = mechanism misses / total misses. The packet target is to drive this DOWN, not to drive hit_rate up.
slope.why_two: hit_rate can rise while mechanism_share is flat, which means questions got easier, not that the learner got better. A rise in hit_rate with a flat mechanism_share is treated as suspect.

session_rules_learned_about_this_learner: Keep questions to ONE OR TWO LINES. The first three answers of 2026-08-26 were verbatim pastes of the teaching material, all following long chunks. After chunk length was cut and questions reduced to one line, every subsequent answer was reasoned, and both clean passes came after the cut.
Weight questions toward 'trace it, step by step' and away from 'name the layer'. mechanism is one habit, not five knowledge gaps.
The checker names the miss code, never the learner.
checker_caveat: Grading was done by the same agent that wrote the questions and taught the material. Frozen ideals live in questions.jsonl so the arrangement can be checked rather than trusted. If hit_rate rises while mechanism_share does not fall, treat the rise as suspect.
